correctness.rationale: For all integers q≥1, split Ind(C6[Kq]) into two disjoint joins of three q-point discrete sets A,B plus exactly 3q² antipodal bridge edges. The C6 quotient of A⊔B is Y=A/C3. Its geometric CW structure has q vertices, q² edges, and (q³+2q)/3 triangles; constant-color triangles with isotropy attach via e_aa ONCE rather than e_aa³. Explicit triangular relations eliminate every loop in pi1(Y); χ(Y)-1=((q−1)^3+2(q−1))/3 gives free H2 and a wedge of S2 by Hurewicz/Whitehead. Opposite-color edge orbits become C(q,2) circle generators and equal-color flipped edges become leaves. Independently enumerated 2q³ maximal parity triples for q=1,2,3; source barycentric quotient checker examined modulo 2,3,5,7 for q≤4 and SNF q≤2. These finite cases are only corroboration; all-q proof is CW stabilizer and π1 argument.
residual_risks: Numerical or finite checks do not establish general cases; general argument independently inspected.
